title: 第1章 意志如钢
content_zh:
烈日当空，山门之前，一名老者手里拿着块微微闪光的方形长石，面对着一群少年少女。

“夏尘，资质测试结果，不合格！”老者把方形长石贴在一名普通少年的腹部，片刻后拿开，看了一眼后，冰冷地喝道。

那少年夏尘眼神微微一黯，但是随即恢复平静，他一言不发，转身向着山下走去。

“以后你不要来了。”那老者皱眉道，“你的资质就是普通凡人，不可能通过修行测试，这不是靠时间长就能改变的，已经五年了，你怎么就没有自知之明？”

“谢谢齐师兄的规劝，不过普通凡人未必不能修行，我不会放弃的。”夏尘语气平静，却如钢铁般不可动摇。

齐师兄冷笑道：“你没有资质，再坚持也是白费时间，一介凡人还妄想修行？荒谬，赶紧走吧，下次别让老夫再看到你。”

夏尘脸色一变：“你不用看不起我，我是没有资质，但是你别忘了，修行最重是机缘，其次是毅力，最次也最不重要才是资质，总有一天，我会成为修行者。”

“呸，什么东西，还妄想机缘，就你这种货色，一辈子也别想成为修行者。”齐师兄脸色发青。

那些少年少女看着夏尘的背影，纷纷投来异样的眼神，窃窃私语着。

“一个外围杂役也想成为正玄派内门弟子？真够不自量力的！”

“就是，齐师兄说他资质不合格，他还敢顶嘴，这家伙真不知道好歹。”

“凡人就这样，没有自知之明，偏偏还想做修行的美梦，哈哈。”

“听说这个杂役已经连续五年参加正玄派内门弟子选拔了，还真是有毅力，可惜他注定没有希望，明知道没有希望还要尝试，不但可悲，而且愚蠢！”

来到山脚下，夏尘看着连绵起伏的正玄山脉，微微出神。

别人的嘲讽打击，对夏尘来说，只是浮云，根本激不起半点涟漪，五年来坚持不懈的修炼，早已让夏尘心智似铁，意志如钢。

没有人知道，夏尘并不属于这个世界，而是从地球穿越而来的一个普通少年。在得知异世界有修行者和修行门派后，夏尘便对修行产生了极大的渴望。

修行者又称为修士，拥有不可思议的神通力量，是世间凡人可望而不可及的超然存在。

正玄派是异世界里，大梁国七大修行门派之一，而夏尘是正玄派外围杂役中的一员。

所谓杂役，就是伺候修行者，替修行门派干杂活的凡人。

当杂役除了可以换取生活必须，最大的好处便是可以修炼真气和粗浅功法，然后有机会参加正玄派内门弟子选拔，如果有幸在三年内修炼出真气感应，便会鲤鱼跳龙门，成为内门弟子。

真气感应，是修行者修炼的第一步，通过呼吸吐纳，在小腹丹田产生真气。只要资质合格，三年之内都可修炼出真气感应，如果超过三年还没有任何感应，那就代表与修行无缘，只是最平凡的普通人。

当然，大多数人都是普通人，夏尘也是，所以始终无法修炼出真气感应。但是在别人都已经放弃的时候，夏尘却始终坚持着。

片刻之后，夏尘默坐在一块岩石上，脑子里摒除一切杂念，开始呼吸吐纳。五年的时间，夏尘无数次的做过这个动作，早已熟极而流，但是却没有一次感应到真气。

运气良久，夏尘睁开眼睛，微微叹气，这一次没有任何悬念，依然是失败。

他不再修炼，而是向着山脚下走去。

远远地，前面出现一片村落，那是正玄派外围杂役的居住地方。

夏尘走到一间简单秀雅的院落前，轻轻敲了敲门。

“谁？”屋里响起一个俏生生的声音。

门开了，出现在夏尘面前的是一名美貌少女，肤色白皙，亭亭玉立。

这美貌少女叫林梦如，是夏尘的女朋友。

“夏尘，你怎么来了？”林梦如看见夏尘，神色有些变化，却没有露出笑容。

“哦……”林梦如微微迟疑了一下，“夏尘，你来的正好，我有些话想跟你说。”

林梦如走到院子中间，背对着他，半响才缓缓道：“你的测试没有通过吧？”

“没有。”夏尘摇头道，“不过没关系，我会继续坚持的，你不用安慰我。”

“我没想安慰你，夏尘，你觉得你的坚持还有意义么？”林梦如忽然叹了口气，转身看着他道。

“你这话什么意思？”夏尘心头一震。

林梦如怜悯地看着他：“夏尘，你只是个凡人，没有修行资质，为什么偏偏还要去做没有希望的事情呢？我觉得我很不理解你！”

夏尘脸色一变：“你要跟我说的就是这个？”

“夏尘……”林梦如神色复杂，欲言又止，半响才道，“你注定是修炼不成的，我觉得我们之间的距离越来越遥远了，不太适合在一起，还是分开吧。”

夏尘脑中嗡的一声，如同挨了一记闷棍。他双目如血，瞪着林梦如，一字一顿：“就因为我是凡人，无法成为修行者，你就要和我分手？”

林梦如淡淡道：“不错，你看看你，一无是处，难道我这辈子要跟个杂役生活么？”

一无是处……夏尘心抽搐起来，他看着林梦如，第一次觉得从前温柔可爱的女友是如此陌生。

“林梦如，我对你怎么样？你心里清楚！你说我对你好，要爱我一辈子，现在我在你眼里，怎么就成了一无是处？”夏尘牙齿咬得咯咯作响。

林梦如脸色一变：“你对我好，我就应该感激你？你知不知道，你对我好是应该的，有的是人排队等着对我好呢，你算什么！”

夏尘胸口仿佛要炸裂一般：“原来我对你的好，在你眼里一钱不值！”

林梦如厌恶地看了他一眼：“夏尘，我就讨厌你这样子，好像是所有人都象欠了你一样，你这辈子，都注定不会有什么出息。”

“呵呵……”夏尘愣住了，半响才惨笑起来：“林梦如，我想问你一句，你到底有没有爱过我？既然嫌弃我是个杂役，那你以前为什么还要跟我在一起？”

林梦如冷笑道：“我以前跟你在一起，是我以为你能进入正玄派当内门弟子，但是你连续五年都没有测试成功，你的人生已经完了，我还要把我的青春年华赌在你身上吗？夏尘，你的坚持的确感动过我，可是现在很多人眼里，包括在我眼里，你就是个笑话！”

夏尘浑身颤抖，心里面仿佛有万针攒刺，忽然，他象是明白了什么，大声道：“林梦如，这话不象是你的口吻，是有人故意教你这么说来打击我吧？别找什么借口，就是你移情别恋了，对不对！”

林梦如脸色变了，双肩一颤，不由自主地退了两步。

忽然，一个冰寒的男子声音从房屋里传出来：“夏尘，你这卑贱的东西，居然敢对我的梦如这样说话？是不是想找死！”

话音落下，一名身材高大，眉清目秀的少年从屋子里走出来。

“严冰，是你。”夏尘鲜血瞬间涌到了头上。

严冰也是杂役，而且还是夏尘的情敌，一直追求林梦如，两人素来不对付，互相敌视。

但是在昨日的选拔中，严冰却测试合格，成为正玄派的内门弟子，那便是高高在上，和夏尘不在一个层次上了。

“夏尘，你这可怜虫。”严冰挂着胜利者才有的笑容，亲密地揽住林梦如肩头，“我已经是正玄派弟子，还想跟我抢梦如，你配吗？你没前途没本事，天生就是当个杂役的命，怎么样，被我戴绿帽子的感觉是不是很爽？”

林梦如脸色通红，她不愿在夏尘面前和严冰如此亲热，但是又不好抗拒，只是低头不语。

夏尘心里恨到了极点，指甲深深陷进掌心，咬牙道：“那我要恭喜你了，严冰，恭喜你接受我的二手货，而且我告诉你，既然她只为了前途找你，那等到出现比你更强的人，你迟早也会被抛弃。”

严冰的笑容僵在脸上，没想到自己成为正玄派弟子，夏尘依然这么强硬，大怒道：“你敢和我这样说话？还想离间我和梦如的感情，不教训你一顿，你真不知道和我的差距。”

他松开林梦如，一个箭步冲上，挥拳向夏尘打去。

夏尘抬手架开，两人都是杂役，也都学了些粗浅的拳脚功夫，但是严冰修炼出真气感应，力量已经强过夏尘，几个回合，便一脚将夏尘踹倒在地上。

严冰狠狠踢着夏尘，狞笑道：“可怜虫，你还以为是从前呢？你知不知道，现在我踩死你，就等于是踩死一只蝼蚁，你这垃圾。”

他脸色狰狞，脚下几乎用了全力，恨不得把夏尘踢死。

“严冰，不要打他了。”林梦如脸色怜悯，叹道，“我以后和他再没有任何瓜葛了，何况你就要进入正玄派，也没必要跟他一般见识。”

严冰重重地踢了夏尘一脚，喝道：“看在梦如的面子上，我放过你，卑贱地东西，给我滚。”

夏尘挣扎着站起身，他全身布满了尘土，脸上被踢得青一块紫一块，嘴角流下一道长长的血线。

整理了一下衣衫，夏尘忽然变得前所未有的平静，寒声道：“严冰，林梦如，今日我无话可说，但是有朝一日，你们对我所做的，我要你们百倍偿还。”

还敢威胁？卑贱地东西，我让你连杂役都当不成……严冰恼恨地看着夏尘的背影，眼中露出凶光。

content_en:
Under the scorching sun, in front of the mountain gate, an old man was facing a group of teenagers and girls, holding a slightly shiny square rectangular stone in his hand.

"Xia Chen, the qualification test result is unqualified!" The old man put the rectangular stone on the abdomen of an ordinary boy, took it away after a moment, took a look, and shouted coldly.

The young man Xia Chen's eyes dimmed slightly, but then he regained his composure. Without saying a word, he turned around and walked down the mountain.

"Don't come here anymore." The old man frowned and said, "Your qualifications are that of an ordinary mortal. It is impossible to pass the practice test. This cannot be changed by time. It has been five years. Why don't you have self-awareness?"

"Thank you, Senior Brother Qi, for your advice, but ordinary mortals may not be unable to practice. I will not give up." Xia Chen's tone was calm, but as unshakable as steel.

Senior Brother Qi sneered: "You have no qualifications. No matter how hard you persist, it will be a waste of time. How can a mortal still want to practice? It's ridiculous. Go away quickly. Don't let me see you again next time."

Xia Chen's expression changed: "You don't have to look down on me. I have no qualifications, but don't forget that the most important thing about cultivation is opportunity, the second is perseverance, and the last and least important is qualification. One day, I will become a practitioner."

"Bah, what the hell are you still dreaming about opportunities? A guy like you will never be able to become a practitioner in your life." Senior Brother Qi's face turned blue.

The boys and girls looked at Xia Chen's back, cast strange looks and whispered to each other.

"A peripheral servant also wants to become an inner disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect? He really overestimates his abilities!"

"That's right, Senior Brother Qi said he was unqualified and he still dared to talk back. This guy really doesn't know what's good or bad."

"Mortals are like this. They have no self-awareness, but they still want to have the dream of practicing, haha."

"I heard that this handyman has participated in the selection of inner disciples of the Zhengxuan Sect for five consecutive years. He is really perseverant. Unfortunately, he is destined to have no hope. He still tries even though he knows there is no hope. It is not only sad, but also stupid!"

Arriving at the foot of the mountain, Xia Chen looked at the rolling Zhengxuan Mountains and was slightly lost in thought.

Others' ridicule and blows are just floating clouds to Xia Chen, which cannot stir up any ripples at all. Five years of unremitting cultivation have already made Xia Chen's mind as iron as iron and his will as steel.

No one knows that Xia Chen does not belong to this world, but is an ordinary boy who traveled from the earth.After learning that there were practitioners and sects of practice in other worlds, Xia Chen developed a great desire for practice.

Practitioners, also known as monks, possess incredible supernatural powers and are transcendent beings that are beyond the reach of ordinary people in the world.

The Zhengxuan Sect is one of the seven major cultivation sects in the Liang Kingdom in a different world, and Xia Chen is one of the peripheral servants of the Zhengxuan Sect.

The so-called handymen are mortals who serve the practitioners and do chores for the sect.

In addition to being able to obtain the necessities of life as a handyman, the biggest benefit is that you can practice Qi and superficial skills, and then have the opportunity to participate in the selection of inner disciples of the Zhengxuan Sect. If you are lucky enough to practice Qi sensing within three years, you will jump over the dragon gate and become an inner disciple.

Qi induction is the first step in a practitioner's practice. Through breathing, Qi is generated in the Dantian of the lower abdomen.As long as you meet the qualifications, you can practice Qi Sensing within three years. If you don't have any Qi Sensing after more than three years, it means that you have no chance of practicing and are just the most ordinary ordinary people.

Of course, most people are ordinary people, and so is Xia Chen, so they have never been able to cultivate Qi sensing.But when others had given up, Xia Chen always persisted.

After a while, Xia Chenmo sat on a rock, got rid of all distracting thoughts in his mind, and began to breathe.Over the past five years, Xia Chen has done this action countless times and has become very familiar with it, but he has never felt the true energy once.

After a long time of luck, Xia Chen opened his eyes and sighed slightly. This time there was no suspense, it was still a failure.

He stopped practicing and walked towards the foot of the mountain.

In the distance, a village appeared in front of them, which was where the peripheral servants of the Zhengxuan Sect lived.

Xia Chen walked to a simple and elegant courtyard and knocked lightly on the door.

"Who?" A playful voice sounded in the room.

The door opened, and what appeared in front of Xia Chen was a beautiful girl with fair complexion and a slim figure.

This beautiful girl's name is Lin Mengru, and she is Xia Chen's girlfriend.

"Xia Chen, why are you here?" Lin Mengru's expression changed slightly when he saw Xia Chen, but he did not smile.

"Oh..." Lin Mengru hesitated slightly, "Xia Chen, you came just in time. I have something to say to you."

Lin Mengru walked to the middle of the yard, turned her back to him, and said slowly after a while: "You didn't pass the test, right?"

"No." Xia Chen shook his head and said, "But it doesn't matter. I will continue to persist. You don't need to comfort me."

"I didn't want to comfort you, Xia Chen, do you think your persistence is still meaningful?" Lin Mengru suddenly sighed, turned around and looked at him.

"What do you mean by this?" Xia Chen was shocked.

Lin Mengru looked at him with pity: "Xia Chen, you are just a mortal and have no cultivation qualifications. Why do you still do hopeless things? I feel like I don't understand you!"

Xia Chen's expression changed: "Is this what you want to tell me?"

"Xia Chen..." Lin Mengru's expression was complicated, he hesitated to speak, and then said after a while, "You are destined to fail in cultivation. I feel that the distance between us is getting farther and farther. It is not suitable for us to be together, so we should separate."

There was a buzz in Xia Chen's head, like a slap in the face.His eyes were bloodshot, and he stared at Lin Mengru, saying word by word: "Just because I am a mortal and cannot become a practitioner, you are going to break up with me?"

Lin Mengru said lightly: "Yes, look at you, you are useless. Am I going to live with a handyman in this life?"

Useless... Xia Chen's heart twitched. He looked at Lin Mengru and felt for the first time that his former gentle and lovely girlfriend was so strange.

"Lin Mengru, how do I treat you? You know it in your heart! You said that I am good to you and that you will love me forever. How come I am useless in your eyes now?" Xia Chen gritted his teeth.

Lin Mengru's expression changed: "You are good to me, so I should be grateful to you? Do you know that you should be good to me? There are many people waiting in line to be good to me. Who do you think you are!"

Xia Chen's chest felt as if it was going to explode: "So my kindness to you is worthless in your eyes!"

Lin Mengru glanced at him with disgust: "Xia Chen, I hate how you behave like this. It seems like everyone owes you. You are destined to have no future in this life."

"Haha..." Xia Chen was stunned, and then laughed miserably for a while: "Lin Mengru, I want to ask you, have you ever loved me? Since you despise me as a handyman, why did you still stay with me before?"

Lin Mengru sneered: "I was with you before because I thought you could enter the Zhengxuan Sect and become an inner disciple. But you have not succeeded in the test for five consecutive years. Your life is over. Do I still want to bet my youth on you? Xia Chen, your persistence has indeed moved me, but now in the eyes of many people, including me, you are just a joke!"

Xia Chen was trembling all over, and his heart felt like thousands of needles were pricking him. Suddenly, he seemed to understand something, and said loudly: "Lin Mengru, this doesn't sound like your tone. Someone deliberately taught you to say this to hurt me, right? Don't make any excuses, it's just that you're in love with someone else, right?"

Lin Mengru's expression changed, her shoulders trembled, and she took two steps back involuntarily.

Suddenly, a cold man's voice came from the house: "Xia Chen, you despicable thing, how dare you speak to my Mengru like this? Are you looking for death?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a tall, handsome young man walked out of the house.

"Yan Bing, it's you." Xia Chen's blood instantly rushed to his head.

Yan Bing is also a handyman and Xia Chen's love rival. He has been pursuing Lin Mengru. The two have never dealt with each other and are hostile to each other.

However, in yesterday's selection, Yan Bing passed the test and became an inner disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect. That meant he was superior and not on the same level as Xia Chen.

"Xia Chen, you poor thing." Yan Bing smiled like a winner and held Lin Mengru's shoulders intimately, "I am already a disciple of the Zhengxuan sect, and you still want to snatch Mengru from me. Are you worthy? You have no future and no ability. You were born to be a handyman. How about it? Doesn't it feel good to be cuckolded by me?"

Lin Mengru's face turned red. She didn't want to be so affectionate with Yan Bing in front of Xia Chen, but she couldn't resist, so she just lowered her head and remained silent.

Xia Chen was so filled with hatred that he dug his nails into his palms and gritted his teeth and said, "Then I would like to congratulate you, Yan Bing, for accepting my second-hand goods. And let me tell you, since she is only looking for you for her future, when someone stronger than you appears, you will be abandoned sooner or later."

Yan Bing's smile froze on his face. He didn't expect that after becoming a disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect, Xia Chen would still be so tough and said angrily: "You dare to talk to me like this? You still want to alienate the relationship between me and Meng Ru. If I don't teach you a lesson, you really don't know the difference between you and me."

He let go of Lin Mengru, rushed forward, and punched Xia Chen.

Xia Chen raised his hand to fight off. They were both handymen and had learned some rudimentary boxing and kicking skills. However, Yan Bing had developed Qi sensing and was stronger than Xia Chen. After a few rounds, he kicked Xia Chen to the ground.

Yan Bing kicked Xia Chen hard and said with a cruel smile: "Poor fellow, do you still think this is the past? Do you know that if I step on you to death now, it will be like trampling to death an ant, you piece of trash?"

His face was ferocious, and he used almost all his strength with his feet, wanting to kick Xia Chen to death.

"Yan Bing, don't hit him." Lin Mengru looked pitiful and sighed, "I will have nothing to do with him in the future. Besides, you are about to join the Zhengxuan Sect, so there is no need to be as knowledgeable as him."

Yan Bing kicked Xia Chen hard and shouted: "For Mengru's sake, I'll let you go. You despicable thing, get out of here."

Xia Chen struggled to stand up. His whole body was covered with dust, his face was bruised and bruised from the kick, and a long line of blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.

After adjusting his clothes, Xia Chen suddenly became calmer than ever before and said in a cold voice: "Yan Bing, Lin Mengru, I have nothing to say today, but one day, I want you to repay a hundred times what you did to me."

Dare you threaten?You despicable thing, I won't let you even become a handyman... Yan Bing looked at Xia Chen's back angrily, with a fierce light in his eyes.
